import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; import { SalesService } from 'src/app/services/sales.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-payment', templateUrl: './payment.component.html', styleUrls: ['./payment.component.css'], }) export class PaymentComponent implements OnInit { orderData: any = {}; isLoading = false; paymentSuccess = false; totalAmount = 0; orderId = ''; showPaymentModal = false; paymentInProgress = false; // Payment method selectedPaymentMethod: string = 'upi'; // UPI fields upiId: string = ''; // Card fields cardNumber: string = ''; expiryDate: string = ''; cvv: string = ''; cardholderName: string = ''; // Shipping address shippingAddress: string = ''; constructor( private router: Router, private salesService: SalesService, ) {} ngOnInit(): void { const savedCart = localStorage.getItem('checkout_cart'); console.log('Saved cart:', savedCart); // Debug if (savedCart) { this.orderData = JSON.parse(savedCart); if (this.orderData.items && this.orderData.items.length > 0) { this.totalAmount = this.orderData.items.reduce( (sum: number, item: any) => { const price = Number(item.price) || 0; const quantity = Number(item.quantity) || 1; console.log( `Item: ${item.name}, Price: ${price}, Qty: ${quantity}`, ); // Debug return sum + price * quantity; }, 0, ); console.log('Total Amount calculated:', this.totalAmount); // Debug } } // Load saved address if exists const savedAddress = localStorage.getItem('shippingAddress'); if (savedAddress) { this.shippingAddress = savedAddress; } } selectPaymentMethod(method: string): void { this.selectedPaymentMethod = method; } formatCardNumber(): void { let value = this.cardNumber.replace(/\s/g, ''); if (value.length > 16) { value = value.slice(0, 16); } this.cardNumber = value.replace(/(\d{4})/g, '$1 ').trim(); } isPaymentValid(): boolean { if (this.selectedPaymentMethod === 'upi') { return this.upiId.length > 0 && this.shippingAddress.length > 0; } else if (this.selectedPaymentMethod === 'card') { const cardNum = this.cardNumber.replace(/\s/g, ''); return ( cardNum.length === 16 && this.expiryDate.length === 5 && this.cvv.length === 3 && this.cardholderName.length > 0 && this.shippingAddress.length > 0 ); } else if (this.selectedPaymentMethod === 'cod') { return this.shippingAddress.length > 0; } return false; } // Show payment confirmation modal confirmPayment(): void { if (!this.isPaymentValid()) { alert('Please fill all required fields'); return; } this.showPaymentModal = true; } // Close modal closeModal(): void { this.showPaymentModal = false; } // Process actual payment processPayment(): void { this.showPaymentModal = false; this.paymentInProgress = true; this.isLoading = true; // Simulate payment processing setTimeout(() => { this.completeOrder(); }, 2000); } // Complete order after payment completeOrder(): void { const buyerName = localStorage.getItem('username'); if (!buyerName) { alert('Please login first'); this.router.navigate(['/login']); return; } // Save shipping address localStorage.setItem('shippingAddress', this.shippingAddress); // Create orders const orders = this.orderData.items?.map((item: any) => ({ itemName: item.name, buyer: buyerName, price: Number(item.price) || 0, quantity: Number(item.quantity) || 1, delivered: false, orderStatus: 'PENDING', orderDate: new Date(), shippingAddress: this.shippingAddress, paymentMethod: this.selectedPaymentMethod, paymentStatus: this.selectedPaymentMethod === 'cod' ? 'PENDING' : 'COMPLETED', })); if (!orders || orders.length === 0) { alert('No items in cart'); this.router.navigate(['/cart']); return; } let completedOrders = 0; let hasError = false; orders.forEach((order: any) => { this.salesService.createOrder(order).subscribe({ next: (response) => { completedOrders++; this.orderId = response.id; if (completedOrders === orders.length && !hasError) { this.paymentInProgress = false; this.isLoading = false; this.paymentSuccess = true; // Clear cart localStorage.removeItem('checkout_cart'); localStorage.removeItem('cart'); // Auto redirect after 3 seconds setTimeout(() => { this.router.navigate(['/orders'], { queryParams: { payment: 'success' }, }); }, 3000); } }, error: (err) => { console.error('Error placing order:', err); hasError = true; this.paymentInProgress = false; this.isLoading = false; alert('Failed to place order. Please try again.'); }, }); }); } goBackToCart(): void { this.router.navigate(['/cart']); } goToOrders(): void { this.router.navigate(['/orders']); } formatPrice(price: number): string { if (!price) return '0'; return price.toLocaleString('en-IN'); } }
